item.title: TF-IDF in OCaml: When Functional Programming Clicks
item.description:
I built Cogitator, a local code search engine in OCaml. It indexes code chunks using TF-IDF, ranks results by cosine similarity, and outputs them as RAG prompts for LLMs. The whole thing is about 500 lines of OCaml.

I didn’t pick OCaml because it was the obvious choice. I picked it because I wanted to learn it. But the language ended up being genuinely good for this problem in ways I didn’t expect.
